title: Performance of intracortical microelectrode arrays in people with implanted brain–computer interfaces over a 20-year period

abstract: Utah arrays recorded stable spiking activity for up to 7.3 years, with modest signal decline on average and sustained movement decoding in the majority of arrays analyzed, demonstrating the long-term feasibility of intracortical brain–computer interfaces. The silicon microelectrode ‘Utah’ array has enabled people with paralysis to control computer cursors, operate prosthetic limbs and communicate using high-performance brain–computer interfaces. However, reports so far have typically been limited to one or two individuals, with no systematic assessment of array longevity, decoding accuracy and day-to-day stability. Here we present a comprehensive 20-year evaluation of neural data from the BrainGate clinical trials, spanning 2,289 recording sessions, 20 arrays and 14 participants. On average, arrays successfully recorded neural spiking waveforms on 35.6% of electrodes, with a modest 7 percentage point decline over the recording period (up to 7.3 years). Using a ‘decoding signal-to-noise ratio’ (dSNR) metric, we found that 11 of 14 arrays provided meaningful movement decoding throughout participation (median dSNR >1), with three achieving >70% accuracy compared with able-bodied mouse control. We also found that dSNR increased approximately logarithmically with the number of electrodes, providing a pathway for scaling performance. While longevity exceeded previous nonhuman primate studies, achieving peak performance consistently may require further improvements.
zh_abstract: Utah阵列记录了长达7.3年的稳定尖峰活动，平均信号下降幅度不大，并且在所分析的大多数阵列中持续实现运动解码，证明了皮层内脑机接口的长期可行性。硅微电极“Utah”阵列已使瘫痪患者能够使用高性能脑机接口控制电脑光标、操作假肢并进行交流。然而，迄今的报道通常仅限于一两个人，尚未对阵列寿命、解码准确性和逐日稳定性进行系统评估。在此，我们展示了对BrainGate临床试验神经数据的全面20年评估，涵盖2,289次记录会话、20个阵列和14名参与者。平均而言，阵列在35.6%的电极上成功记录了神经尖峰波形，在记录期间（长达7.3年）仅出现7个百分点的适度下降。使用“解码信噪比”（decoding signal-to-noise ratio, dSNR）指标，我们发现14个阵列中有11个在整个参与期间提供了有意义的运动解码（中位dSNR >1），其中3个与健全受试者的鼠标控制相比达到>70%的准确率。我们还发现dSNR随电极数量近似对数增加，为扩展性能提供了途径。尽管其寿命超过了先前的非人灵长类研究，但要始终达到峰值性能可能仍需进一步改进。

abstract: [Journal of the American Medical Informatics Association : JAMIA] To understand how rural hospitals use artificial intelligence (AI) and identify ways to reduce the barriers to safe, effective use of high-quality tools that align with these hospitals' key priorities. Stratified random sample drawn from the full population of critical access hospitals (CAHs) in the United States in 2025 (n = 1377) to approximate proportional representation of the 4 census regions. We conducted in-depth qualitative interviews with hospital leadership (eg, CMIOs, CIOs, IT leads) tasked with decision-making about technology. Interviews were conducted between October 20, 2025, and January 23, 2026. Drawn from the full population of CAHs in the US in 2025, 256 hospitals were sampled and interviews were completed for a total of 50 CAHs represented by 73 interview participants. Generative AI applications were more common and seen as more valuable for CAH contexts than traditional predictive AI. Primary barriers included infrastructure limitations, cost, and lack of transparency on how AI tools worked. Despite a desire to implement robust governance, most CAHs did not have the ability to do so and reported a critical need for information, tools, and policies to build their AI governance capacity. Information (peer learning, information from non-commercial sources), tools (registries, model cards), and policy to support technical capacity were perceived as the most responsive ways to build capacity. To reduce structural barriers to safe and effective AI decision-making, resources and investment should focus on information sharing with and across rural organizations, AI governance support, and transparency efforts. This will support CAHs in judiciously leveraging available resources and prevent waste on low-quality or misaligned AI tools.

abstract: [Gastric cancer : official journal of the International Gastric Cancer Association and the Japanese Gastric Cancer Association] Selecting adjuvant chemotherapy for gastric cancer requires balancing tumor risk and patient-related factors. We developed and internally validated a recurrent deep survival machine (RDSM) framework to evaluate whether concordance with AI-recommended treatment is associated with overall survival (OS). This retrospective cohort study analyzed 15,848 patients with stage II-III gastric cancer from the Japanese Gastric Cancer Association (2011, 2013). Patients receiving neoadjuvant therapy, non-standard regimens, or dying within 8 weeks post-surgery were excluded. Patients were categorized as AI-recommended or AI-non-recommended based on whether their treatment matched the model-derived recommendation (the regimen with the highest predicted 5-year survival probability). Primary outcome was 5-year OS. Model performance was evaluated using the concordance index (C-index), and multiple imputation with propensity score overlap weighting (MI-OW) was used for the observational comparison of treatment concordance. RDSM showed superior discrimination compared with the Cox model (C-index, 0.77 vs. 0.73). After MI-OW, concordance with AI-recommended treatment was associated with higher 5-year OS than discordance (74.00% vs. 66.16%; adjusted difference, 7.84 percentage points [95% CI, 6.06-9.62]). A similar association was observed among patients aged ≥ 75 years (64.18% vs. 52.76%; adjusted difference, 11.42 percentage points [95% CI, 6.72-16.12]). These associations are not causal treatment effects. SHAP analyses highlighted patient-related factors for S-1 monotherapy and tumor burden for S-1 plus oxaliplatin. RDSM identified model-derived treatment patterns associated with observed OS differences, without establishing benefits from AI-guided treatment changes. External validation and prospective evaluation are needed before clinical use.
zh_abstract: [Gastric Cancer：International Gastric Cancer Association与Japanese Gastric Cancer Association官方期刊] 为胃癌选择辅助化疗需要平衡肿瘤风险和患者相关因素。我们开发并在内部验证了一种循环深度生存机器（RDSM）框架，以评估与AI推荐治疗的一致性是否与总生存（OS）相关。这项回顾性队列研究分析了来自日本胃癌协会（2011、2013）的15,848例II-III期胃癌患者。接受新辅助治疗、非标准方案或术后8周内死亡的患者被排除。根据其治疗是否与模型推导的推荐一致（预测5年生存概率最高的方案），患者被分为AI推荐组或AI非推荐组。主要结局为5年OS。模型性能使用一致性指数（C-index）评估，并采用多重插补结合倾向评分重叠加权（MI-OW）对治疗一致性进行观察性比较。与Cox模型相比，RDSM显示出更优的区分能力（C-index，0.77 vs. 0.73）。MI-OW后，与AI推荐治疗一致与更高的5年OS相关（74.00% vs. 66.16%；校正差异，7.84个百分点[95% CI，6.06-9.62]）。在年龄≥75岁的患者中也观察到类似关联（64.18% vs. 52.76%；校正差异，11.42个百分点[95% CI，6.72-16.12]）。这些关联并非因果治疗效应。SHAP分析突出显示了S-1单药治疗的患者相关因素以及S-1联合奥沙利铂的肿瘤负荷。RDSM识别出与观察到的OS差异相关的模型推导治疗模式，但未确立AI指导的治疗改变可带来获益。在临床使用前需要外部验证和前瞻性评估。

abstract: [Medicina (Kaunas, Lithuania)] Background and Objectives: AI-assisted retinal imaging is increasingly proposed to expand diabetic retinopathy (DR) screening capacity, but most validation studies use reading-center standards, exclude prediabetes, and assess macular edema against photographic surrogates rather than optical coherence tomography (OCT). We compared an AI-assisted retinal screening system with routine ophthalmological examination in an unselected internal medicine screening population. Materials and Methods: In this prospective, cross-sectional diagnostic accuracy study, consecutive adults with prediabetes or diabetes underwent AI-assisted retinal imaging (index test) followed by masked ophthalmological examination (reference standard), with OCT as the reference for macular edema. Analyses were performed at the eye level (n = 714) and patient level (n = 357) using Wilson score 95% confidence intervals and Cohen kappa (κ) for agreement. Results: Among 357 patients (714 eyes; 83.8% diabetes, 16.2% prediabetes), DR prevalence by ophthalmological examination was 15.0% (eyes) and 17.9% (patients), versus 24.4% and 33.1% by AI (McNemar p < 0.001). Eye-level and patient-level sensitivity and specificity were 70.1% and 83.7% and 75.0% and 76.1%, respectively. Negative predictive value was high (93-94%) but positive predictive value was low (41-43%); agreement was moderate at the eye level and fair at the patient level (κ = 0.428 and 0.384, respectively). False-positive AI calls were associated with higher HbA1c and albuminuria (adjusted odds ratio for log-transformed ACR 1.23, p = 0.040); false negatives had milder disease. In prediabetes, DR prevalence was 1.7% and agreement was absent (κ = -0.03). AI sensitivity for OCT-defined macular edema was 45.5% (κ = 0.197), with no significant central macular thickness difference by AI status. Conclusions: The AI system showed high negative predictive value but systematically over-called DR, with only fair-to-moderate agreement and performance below accepted screening benchmarks, particularly in prediabetes and for macular edema. These findings support its use as a rule-out triage adjunct with ophthalmological confirmation of positive results, rather than an autonomous substitute, and argue for local recalibration before deployment.
zh_abstract: [Medicina (Kaunas, Lithuania)]【背景与目的】AI辅助视网膜成像越来越多被提出用于扩大糖尿病视网膜病变（DR）筛查能力，但大多数验证研究使用阅片中心标准、排除糖尿病前期，并且用照片替代指标而非光学相干断层扫描（OCT）评估黄斑水肿。我们在未选择的内部医学筛查人群中比较了AI辅助视网膜筛查系统与常规眼科检查。【材料与方法】在这项前瞻性、横断面诊断准确性研究中，连续纳入的糖尿病前期或糖尿病成人接受AI辅助视网膜成像（指标试验），随后接受盲法眼科检查（参考标准），并以OCT作为黄斑水肿的参考。分析在眼水平（n = 714）和患者水平（n = 357）进行，使用Wilson评分95%置信区间和Cohen kappa（κ）评估一致性。【结果】在357例患者（714眼；83.8%糖尿病，16.2%糖尿病前期）中，眼科检查的DR患病率为15.0%（眼）和17.9%（患者），而AI为24.4%和33.1%（McNemar p < 0.001）。眼水平和患者水平的敏感性及特异性分别为70.1%与83.7%及75.0%与76.1%。阴性预测值高（93-94%），但阳性预测值低（41-43%）；眼水平一致性中等，患者水平一致性一般（κ分别为0.428和0.384）。AI假阳性判断与较高的HbA1c和蛋白尿相关（对数转换ACR的校正比值比1.23，p = 0.040）；假阴性者疾病较轻。在糖尿病前期中，DR患病率为1.7%，且无一致性（κ = -0.03）。AI对OCT定义黄斑水肿的敏感性为45.5%（κ = 0.197），按AI状态分组的黄斑中心凹厚度无显著差异。【结论】该AI系统显示高阴性预测值，但系统性地过度判定DR，一致性仅为一般至中等，性能低于公认筛查基准，尤其是在糖尿病前期和黄斑水肿方面。这些发现支持将其作为排除性分诊辅助工具，并对阳性结果进行眼科确认，而非自主替代，并主张在部署前进行本地重新校准。

abstract: Tumor evolution in lung adenocarcinoma (LUAD) drives drug resistance and disease progression, yet the cellular transitions underlying the malignant transformation of cells remain poorly understood. Comparing this progression of cancer cells across patients is challenging owing to substantial inter-patient cell heterogeneity. Here, based on single-nucleus RNA sequencing (snRNA-seq) data of 227 patients with LUAD including 422,727 tumor cells, we conducted a comprehensive investigation of tumor cell progression and developed Global Tumor Time (GTT), a continuous measure of tumor cell progression across patients. GTT provided a scalable and biologically meaningful metric of tumor progression that aligned with clinicopathological, transcriptomic and spatial characteristics of malignancy and demonstrated robust prognostic performance (C-index = 0.60), which was further validated in two external datasets comprising snRNA-seq (C-index = 0.66) and bulk RNA sequencing (C-index = 0.61). Using explainable AI to investigate the molecular correlates of GTT, we identified two distinct transcriptional programs associated with early and late progression states. These findings establish a scalable and interpretable framework for reconstructing malignant cell transformation across patients and allow for investigating the biology of tumor progression at single-cell resolution.
zh_abstract: 肺腺癌（LUAD）中的肿瘤演化驱动耐药和疾病进展，然而细胞恶性转化所涉及的细胞转变仍知之甚少。由于患者间细胞异质性显著，跨患者比较癌细胞这一进展具有挑战性。在此，基于227例LUAD患者（包括422,727个肿瘤细胞）的单核RNA测序（snRNA-seq）数据，我们对肿瘤细胞进展进行了全面研究，并开发了Global Tumor Time（GTT），一种跨患者衡量肿瘤细胞进展的连续指标。GTT提供了一种可扩展且具有生物学意义的肿瘤进展度量，与恶性肿瘤的临床病理、转录组和空间特征相一致，并表现出稳健的预后性能（C-index = 0.60），并在两个外部数据集中得到进一步验证，分别包含snRNA-seq（C-index = 0.66）和bulk RNA sequencing（C-index = 0.61）。使用可解释AI研究GTT的分子相关性，我们识别出两个与早期和晚期进展状态相关的不同转录程序。这些发现建立了一个可扩展且可解释的框架，用于跨患者重建恶性细胞转化，并允许在单细胞分辨率下研究肿瘤进展的生物学。

abstract: [Medical sciences (Basel, Switzerland)] Background/Objectives: Up to 40% of patients receiving cardiac resynchronization therapy (CRT) do not experience significant clinical improvement, highlighting the limitations of conventional selection criteria. Artificial intelligence (AI) is increasingly being applied to electrocardiogram (ECG) and other clinical data to improve patient selection. This systematic review and meta-analysis evaluated the performance and methodological quality of machine learning (ML) and deep learning (DL) models using ECG-derived information to predict CRT response and clinical outcomes. Methods: A systematic literature search was conducted in Scopus and Web of Science for studies published between January 2006 and April 2026. Eligible studies developed or evaluated ML or DL algorithms primarily using pre-implantation ECG data to predict CRT response, including changes in left ventricular ejection fraction (LVEF) or left ventricular end-systolic volume (LVESV), or mortality. Methodological quality and risk of bias were assessed using the PROBAST+AI tool. Results: We identified 14 eligible studies containing 34 distinct model evaluations. Most models utilized digital 12-lead ECG waveforms or single representative beats. abstract: [Bioengineering (Basel, Switzerland)] Creatinine, estimated glomerular filtration rate and histology detect kidney disease late and say little about the molecular heterogeneity driving progression. Artificial intelligence can extract molecular features from biofluid omics; digitised biopsies and retinal images supply proxy readouts, not molecular measurements. In this review we grouped the literature by histopathology, multi-omics, foundation models and noninvasive systems and checked each result against its cohort, endpoint and validation setting. Reported performance is often high, but most results come from retrospective single-cohort evaluations; external and prospective validation are uncommon, and we found no study among those reviewed showing improved patient outcomes. High discrimination therefore establishes technical performance only; clinical utility and patient benefit remain untested. The evidence to date supports feasibility, not benefit, and the weakness lies in evaluation design rather than model architecture. The evidence so far establishes feasibility, not benefit. Until prospective studies on shared external cohorts are available, these tools are best used to augment existing diagnostic practice, with patient outcomes as the measure of success.

abstract: [Bioethics] It has recently been proposed that fine-tuned large-language models (LLMs) could more accurately predict the preferences of incapacitated patients than surrogates. This hypothetical technology has been named the personalised patient preference predictor (P4). Advocates of the P4 claim that the P4 will not only more accurately predict patient preferences, but will better respect patient autonomy, facilitate the composition of advance directives, and reduce the emotional burden of surrogate decision-making. I challenge these purported benefits by arguing that the P4 would pose a substantive risk to our ability to meaningfully grapple with death. Drawing on the philosophies of Søren Kierkegaard and Martin Heidegger, I argue that adopting an existential attitude towards death is central to the pursuit of an ethical life. Implementation of the P4 risks inhibiting both patients and surrogates from adopting an existential attitude towards death, with deleterious consequences.
zh_abstract: [Bioethics] 最近有人提出，经过微调的大型语言模型（LLMs）可能比替代决策者更准确地预测丧失决策能力患者的偏好。这项假设性技术被命名为个性化患者偏好预测器（personalised patient preference predictor, P4）。P4 的支持者声称，P4 不仅能更准确地预测患者偏好，还能更好地尊重患者自主性、促进预先指示的订立，并减轻替代决策的情感负担。我通过论证 P4 将对我们有意义地应对死亡的能力构成实质性风险，来质疑这些所谓益处。借鉴索伦·克尔凯郭尔（Søren Kierkegaard）和马丁·海德格尔（Martin Heidegger）的哲学，我认为对死亡采取存在主义态度对于追求伦理生活至关重要。实施 P4 有可能阻碍患者和替代决策者双方对死亡采取存在主义态度，并带来有害后果。

abstract: [Diagnostics (Basel, Switzerland)] Artificial intelligence (AI) is moving from stand-alone accuracy studies to prospective deployment across breast screening, risk prediction, multimodal diagnosis, treatment response, and workflow support. The goal of this narrative review is to determine which AI applications have demonstrated clinical benefit, which remain technically promising, and what safeguards are required for implementation. We synthesize randomized trials, prospective cohorts, real-world implementations, external validations, systematic reviews, and guidance identified in PubMed/MEDLINE and Scopus through 30 June 2026. In screening, AI-supported mammography can increase cancer detection and reduce reading workload, but effects depend on whether AI is used as concurrent support, an independent reader, triage, or partial autonomy; autonomous workflows may shift work and cost downstream through additional recalls. MASAI met its prespecified noninferiority criterion for interval cancer, but this should not be interpreted as proof of equivalence or mortality benefit. Image-based risk models often discriminate better than density or conventional clinical models, although prospective benefit from AI-guided allocation to supplemental imaging has not yet been demonstrated. Evidence for contrast-enhanced mammography (CEM), MRI, ultrasound, radiomics, and multimodal models is less mature and limited by external validation, domain shift, missing data, operator dependence, and uncertain incremental value beyond clinicopathological factors. Ungrounded large language models and opaque foundation models are not suitable for autonomous clinical advice. Current evidence therefore supports controlled, task-specific integration rather than radiologist replacement; real clinical benefit depends on governance of the whole AI-enabled pathway, including local validation, human factors, downstream resource use, statistical stopping rules, and fallback procedures.
zh_abstract: [Diagnostics (Basel, Switzerland)]人工智能（AI）正从独立的准确性研究转向在乳腺筛查、风险预测、多模态诊断、治疗反应和流程支持中的前瞻性部署。本叙述性综述旨在确定哪些AI应用已显示临床获益、哪些在技术上仍有前景，以及实施需要哪些保障措施。我们综合了截至2026年6月30日在PubMed/MEDLINE和Scopus中检索到的随机试验、前瞻性队列、真实世界实施、外部验证、系统评价和指南。在筛查中，AI支持的乳腺X线摄影可提高癌症检出并减少阅片工作量，但效果取决于AI是作为同步支持、独立阅片者、分诊还是部分自主使用；自主工作流程可能通过额外召回将工作和成本转移到下游。MASAI达到了其预设的间隔期癌症非劣效性标准，但这不应被解释为等效性或死亡率获益的证据。基于图像的风险模型通常比密度或传统临床模型具有更好的区分度，尽管AI指导分配补充影像的前瞻性获益尚未得到证实。对比增强乳腺X线摄影（CEM）、MRI、超声、影像组学和多模态模型的证据较不成熟，并受外部验证、域偏移、缺失数据、操作者依赖性以及超越临床病理因素的增量价值不确定的限制。无依据的大型语言模型和不透明的基础模型不适合用于自主临床建议。因此，当前证据支持受控的、任务特定的整合，而非替代放射科医生；真正的临床获益取决于对整个AI赋能路径的治理，包括本地验证、人为因素、下游资源使用、统计停止规则和回退程序。

abstract: [Facial plastic surgery : FPS] Aims and Backgrounds: Artificial intelligence (AI) has rapidly expanding applications in diagnosis, surgical planning, and postoperative care. This state-of-the-art review characterizes the growth and use of AI across perioperative care with particular attention to microvascular and free flap reconstruction, and examines how this growth compares with the pace of clinical validation. Techniques: PubMed (MEDLINE), Scopus, and Web of Science were searched through August 10, 2026 for studies evaluating AI in facial plastic surgery, oral and maxillofacial surgery, microvascular head and neck surgery, and facial reanimation. Pediatric-only, non-English, and non-AI-focused studies were excluded. Conclusions and Clinical Relevance: Of 1,249 articles, 66 met inclusion criteria. Preoperative applications accounted for 50% of studies, focusing on surgical planning, image segmentation, and risk stratification. Postoperative applications accounted for 45%, including free flap monitoring and outcome assessment. Intraoperative applications represented 6%. Deep learning and convolutional neural networks were the most common approaches, while few studies included prospective evaluation. AI use has grown rapidly in facial plastic and reconstructive surgery, with uses in preoperative planning, risk prediction, and postoperative free flap monitoring. Despite growth, clinical validation and prospective evaluation remain limited, particularly for intraoperative applications. Research focused on prospective application of technology will determine how AI can be safely incorporated into facial reconstructive surgery.

abstract: [Cancers] Artificial intelligence (AI) models for solid renal mass characterization show promising discrimination in multicenter and some prospective test sets, yet little published evidence supports their routine clinical use. We examine four translation gaps. Independent, representative validation remains limited, and most studies use resected, pathologically confirmed masses, underrepresenting small indeterminate lesions managed by biopsy or surveillance. Recent multicenter models, including RenalCLIP and MPANet, broadened tasks and external testing but remain retrospective. Four retrospective reader experiments suggest that AI assistance can improve readers' accuracy or consistency, but no study identified measured effects on management or patient outcomes. Regulatory evidence is limited: one renal tool reported by its manufacturer as certified under the European Union Medical Device Regulation rests on a single-center retrospective reader study of detection and reporting, and no characterization device was identified in the U.S. Food and Drug Administration AI-enabled device list. The 2026 European Association of Urology guidelines discuss AI as an emerging technology without a graded recommendation. Cost, information technology integration, trust, and interpretability further restrict adoption. We propose a roadmap built around one intended use, the small indeterminate solid mass considered for biopsy or surveillance, with prespecified thresholds, target-specific reference standards, and paired management and safety endpoints.
zh_abstract: [Cancers] 用于实性肾肿块表征的人工智能（AI）模型在多中心和一些前瞻性测试集中显示出有前景的区分能力，但已发表的证据很少支持其常规临床使用。我们考察了四个转化差距。独立、具有代表性的验证仍然有限，且大多数研究使用切除的、经病理确诊的肿块，对通过活检或监测管理的小的不确定性病变代表性不足。近期的多中心模型，包括RenalCLIP和MPANet，拓宽了任务和外部测试，但仍是回顾性的。四项回顾性阅片者实验提示AI辅助可提高阅片者的准确性或一致性，但未发现任何研究测量了对管理或患者结局的影响。监管证据有限：一种肾工具由其制造商报告为根据欧盟医疗器械法规（EU MDR）认证，但其依据是一项单中心回顾性阅片者检测和报告研究，并且在美国食品药品监督管理局（FDA）AI赋能器械清单中未识别到任何表征器械。2026年欧洲泌尿外科学会（EAU）指南将AI讨论为新兴技术，但未给出分级推荐。成本、信息技术整合、信任和可解释性进一步限制了采用。我们提出一个路线图，围绕一个预期用途构建，即考虑活检或监测的小的不确定性实性肿块，并预设阈值、针对目标的参考标准以及配对的处置与安全性终点。

abstract: [Frontiers in public health] Artificial intelligence (AI) is increasingly applied to influenza prevention and control. AI encompasses conventional machine learning, deep learning, and protein language models. Large language models (LLMs) are an emerging subset of AI. Current evidence remains weakly linked to real-world workflows and population health outcomes. This structured narrative review proposes a three-stage translational maturity framework. Phase I is technical efficacy assessment. Phase II is implementation effectiveness verification. Phase III is population impact and sustainability. We synthesized evidence in three domains: viral evolution prediction and vaccine design; epidemic surveillance and early warning; and individual-level infection risk detection and clinical monitoring. We used a three-level evidence hierarchy. Level A is influenza-specific evidence. Level B is transferable evidence from other infectious diseases. Level C is general biomedical or methodological evidence. Only two Phase II studies were identified, both in epidemic surveillance and early warning; no Phase II studies were identified in virus evolution and vaccine design or in individual-level infection risk detection. No study met the prespecified Phase III criteria. Phase III requires demonstrated downstream population health benefit. Prospective deployment or improved forecasting alone is not sufficient. Across domains, bottlenecks have shifted from model accuracy to governance, interpretability, accountability, interoperability, workflow integration, equity, and sustainable monitoring. LLMs attract major attention, but their influenza-specific evidence remains limited. Their greatest value may lie in augmenting, not replacing, specialized models and human expertise. We propose phase-specific evidence thresholds, implementation-oriented evaluation metrics, an implementation readiness checklist, and priority evidence gaps for translating AI-enabled influenza tools into implementation-ready public health applications.
zh_abstract: [Frontiers in public health] 人工智能（AI）正日益应用于流感预防与控制。AI包括传统机器学习、深度学习和蛋白质语言模型。大语言模型（LLMs）是AI的一个新兴子集。当前证据与真实世界工作流程和人群健康结局之间的联系仍然较弱。本结构化叙述性综述提出一个三阶段转化成熟度框架。阶段I为技术效能评估。阶段II为实施效果验证。阶段III为人群影响与可持续性。我们综合了三个领域的证据：病毒进化预测与疫苗设计；流行病学监测与早期预警；以及个体层面感染风险检测与临床监测。我们采用三级证据层级。A级为流感特异性证据。B级为来自其他传染病的可迁移证据。C级为一般生物医学或方法学证据。仅识别出两项阶段II研究，均在流行病学监测与早期预警领域；在病毒进化与疫苗设计或个体层面感染风险检测领域未识别出阶段II研究。没有研究符合预设的阶段III标准。阶段III要求已证明的下游人群健康获益。仅前瞻性部署或改进预测是不够的。跨领域来看，瓶颈已从模型准确性转向治理、可解释性、问责、互操作性、工作流程整合、公平性和可持续监测。LLMs受到大量关注，但其流感特异性证据仍然有限。其最大价值可能在于增强而非取代专门模型和人类专业知识。我们提出针对阶段的证据阈值、面向实施的评价指标、实施就绪检查表，以及将AI赋能的流感工具转化为实施就绪的公共卫生应用所需的优先证据缺口。

title: BYSTER: multimodal graph learning resolves bystander versus tumor-specific T cell states in the tumor immune microenvironment

abstract: Bystander T cells infiltrate tumors without recognizing tumor antigens and constitute a substantial component of the tumor microenvironment. Whether they are passive residents or active participants in antitumor immunity, and how they influence immunotherapy response, remains poorly understood, largely because transcriptional states and T-cell receptor (TCR) sequences alone do not reliably resolve antigen specificity. Here, we developed BYSTER, a heterogeneous graph neural network that integrates transcriptional representations with paired TCR representations through cross-modal message passing at metacell and metaTCR resolution. Across three datasets with distinct definitions of tumor specificity, BYSTER achieved mean AUROCs of 0.729 to 0.920, outperforming unimodal and conventional multimodal baselines, and ablation analyses confirmed the contribution of cross-modal message passing. Application to lung and pancreatic cancer cohorts revealed distinct biological characteristics of the two predicted populations. Bystander T cells were enriched for naive and memory subsets and MAIT-like cells expressing SLC4A10, and exhibited inflammatory and cellular stress-associated programs, including TNF signaling via NF-{kappa}B and hypoxia. Notably, these transcriptional patterns were consistent across lung and pancreatic cancers, with tumor-specific T cells showing enrichment of cell cycle and proliferation-associated programs in both cancer types. Spatial analyses further revealed distinct inferred communication patterns, with bystander T cells showing associations with inflammatory ligand-receptor interactions involving myeloid populations. Responders to immunotherapy contributed a larger proportion of the predicted bystander compartment, suggesting an association between bystander T-cell abundance and an immune-responsive microenvironment. BYSTER thus links predicted T-cell antigen specificity to transcriptional states, spatial organization and clinical response, highlighting the potential importance of bystander T cells in tumor immunity.
zh_abstract: 旁观者T细胞浸润肿瘤但不识别肿瘤抗原，构成肿瘤微环境的重要部分。它们是被动驻留者还是抗肿瘤免疫的主动参与者，以及它们如何影响免疫治疗反应，仍知之甚少，主要原因在于仅凭转录状态和T细胞受体（TCR）序列无法可靠解析抗原特异性。在此，我们开发了BYSTER，一种异质图神经网络，通过metacell和metaTCR分辨率上的跨模态消息传递，将转录表征与配对TCR表征整合起来。在三个对肿瘤特异性有不同定义的数据集中，BYSTER的平均AUROC为0.729至0.920，优于单模态和传统多模态基线，消融分析证实了跨模态消息传递的贡献。应用于肺癌和胰腺癌队列，揭示了两个预测群体的不同生物学特征。旁观者T细胞富集初始和记忆亚群以及表达SLC4A10的MAIT样细胞，并表现出炎症和细胞应激相关程序，包括经NF-κB的TNF信号传导和缺氧。值得注意的是，这些转录模式在肺癌和胰腺癌中一致，肿瘤特异性T细胞在两种癌症类型中均显示细胞周期和增殖相关程序的富集。空间分析进一步揭示了不同的推断通讯模式，旁观者T细胞显示出与涉及髓系群体的炎症配体-受体相互作用的关联。免疫治疗应答者贡献了更大比例的预测旁观者区室，提示旁观者T细胞丰度与免疫应答性微环境之间存在关联。因此，BYSTER将预测的T细胞抗原特异性与转录状态、空间组织和临床反应联系起来，突显了旁观者T细胞在肿瘤免疫中的潜在重要性。

abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI) agents are evolving from research assistants into end-to-end executors, yet their capacity to generate conclusions at scale outpaces rigorous verification. Here we introduce an auditability-centred paradigm for scientific automation, wherein trust relies not on generative capability or self-evaluation, but on whether claims can be independently traced to primary evidence, reviewed and corrected. Moving beyond post-hoc checks, we embed verification throughout the research lifecycle via four principles: grounded knowledge, bounded execution, evidence-backed results and independent verification. We instantiate this paradigm in EvoTrace for viral evolutionary analysis. Distilling peer-review critiques and methodological literature, we curated 13 principles, 236 pitfalls and 50 analytical units - validating 47 across a six-tier hierarchy - to encode methodological limits as executable constraints. Across simulated benchmarks, six viral datasets and an end-to-end Crimean-Congo haemorrhagic fever virus (CCHFV) study, claim-evidence auditing compiled evidence packages for all 233 analyses (flagging 26 incomplete evidentiary chains), while independent numerical and figure audits rectified 17 flaws, including three blocker-level errors. For CCHFV, EvoTrace intercepted a data-contradictory claim, recalibrating 'no reassortment candidates' to 'no high-confidence candidates'. By co-delivering verification evidence, auditable automation shifts AI-driven science from autonomous generation to continuous scrutiny and correction.
zh_abstract: 人工智能（AI）智能体正从研究助理演变为端到端执行者，但其大规模生成结论的能力已超过严格验证的能力。在此，我们引入一种以可审计性为中心的科学自动化范式，其中信任不依赖于生成能力或自我评估，而依赖于主张能否被独立追溯至原始证据、接受审查并得到纠正。超越事后检查，我们通过四项原则将验证嵌入整个研究生命周期：有根据的知识、有界执行、证据支持的结果和独立验证。我们在EvoTrace中实例化这一范式，用于病毒进化分析。通过提炼同行评审批评和方法学文献，我们整理了13项原则、236个陷阱和50个分析单元——在六级层级中验证了47项——以将方法学局限编码为可执行约束。在模拟基准、六个病毒数据集和一项端到端克里米亚-刚果出血热病毒（CCHFV）研究中，主张-证据审计为全部233项分析汇编了证据包（标记出26条不完整证据链），而独立的数值和图表审计纠正了17个缺陷，包括三个阻断级错误。对于CCHFV，EvoTrace拦截了一项与数据相矛盾的主张，将‘无重配候选’重新校准为‘无高置信度候选’。通过共同提供验证证据，可审计自动化将AI驱动的科学从自主生成转向持续审查和纠正。

title: RIPPLE: learning nucleotide relations in an RNA foundation model

abstract: RNA function depends on interactions between nucleotides that can be widely separated in sequence, yet capturing these relationships remains challenging for RNA language models. Existing approaches primarily learn nucleotide relationships implicitly from individual nucleotide reconstruction or rely on external structural information to model nucleotide interactions. Here we introduce RIPPLE, an RNA foundation model that learns to identify and represent sparse, predictively useful nucleotide relationships directly from sequence. Pretrained on 32.4 million RNA sequences, RIPPLE uses pairwise predictive utility to guide relational learning, transferring training-time supervision into a sequence-only model without requiring structural inputs at inference. RIPPLE improves overall performance across five downstream tasks spanning RNA family classification, ribosome loading prediction, secondary-structure prediction, three-dimensional contact prediction, and splice-site recognition. Mechanistic analyses further show that utility-guided learning improves the recovery of informative interactions and enhances the transferability of learned RNA representations.
zh_abstract: RNA功能取决于序列上可能相距很远的核苷酸之间的相互作用，然而捕获这些关系对RNA语言模型仍具有挑战性。现有方法主要从单个核苷酸重建中隐式学习核苷酸关系，或依赖外部结构信息来建模核苷酸相互作用。在此，我们介绍RIPPLE，一种RNA基础模型，它直接从序列中学习识别和表示稀疏的、具有预测实用性的核苷酸关系。RIPPLE在3240万条RNA序列上预训练，使用成对预测效用指导关系学习，将训练时的监督迁移到仅需序列的模型中，在推理时不需要结构输入。RIPPLE在五个下游任务上提升了整体性能，涵盖RNA家族分类、核糖体装载预测、二级结构预测、三维接触预测和剪接位点识别。机制分析进一步表明，效用引导学习改善了信息性相互作用的恢复，并增强了所学RNA表示的可迁移性。

abstract: [Dentistry journal] Background/Objectives: Artificial intelligence (AI) research in endodontics has grown quickly, but the strength of the evidence differs between applications. This narrative review with structured evidence mapping examined diagnostic imaging, canal morphology, outcome prediction, large language models (LLMs), robotics and augmented reality, and operational uses such as case-difficulty assessment, triage and scheduling. Methods: Two anchor reviews were combined with a documented PubMed search to 30 September 2026, and studies were classified by design, sample, reference standard, validation, and evidence of clinical utility. Results: Periapical lesion detection has the largest evidence base: one meta-analysis reported pooled sensitivity of 0.925 and specificity of 0.852, although most included studies were at risk of bias and none was prospective. Fracture detection relies mainly on ex vivo data and is sensitive to image resolution. Outcome models showed modest to moderate discrimination in single-centre data. LLM studies reported 40% to 100% correct, appropriate, or concordant responses across different benchmarks and scoring rules, and outputs varied on repeated querying. Difficulty-assessment and scheduling tools have appeared since 2020 but have not been evaluated prospectively in clinical workflow. Conclusions: Technical performance has not yet been shown to translate into clinical benefit, and AI in endodontics should currently be used only as clinician-supervised decision support.
zh_abstract: [Dentistry journal] 【背景/目的】牙髓病学中的人工智能（AI）研究增长迅速，但证据强度因应用而异。本叙述性综述采用结构化证据映射，考察了诊断影像、根管形态、结局预测、大语言模型（LLMs）、机器人技术与增强现实，以及病例难度评估、分诊和排程等操作性用途。【方法】将两篇锚定综述与截至2026年9月30日的、有记录的PubMed检索相结合，并按设计、样本、参考标准、验证和临床效用证据对研究进行分类。【结果】根尖周病变检测的证据基础最大：一项荟萃分析报告合并敏感性为0.925、特异性为0.852，尽管多数纳入研究存在偏倚风险，且无一为前瞻性研究。骨折检测主要依赖离体数据，并对图像分辨率敏感。结局模型在单中心数据中显示出轻度至中度的判别力。大语言模型研究报告，在不同基准和评分规则下，正确、恰当或一致的应答比例为40%至100%，且重复查询时输出会发生变化。难度评估和排程工具自2020年以来已经出现，但尚未在临床工作流程中进行前瞻性评估。【结论】技术性能尚未被证明可转化为临床获益，目前牙髓病学中的人工智能应仅作为临床医生监督下的决策支持使用。

abstract: [Medicina (Kaunas, Lithuania)] Background and Objectives: Diabetic retinopathy (DR) remains a leading cause of preventable vision loss. Staging based on colour fundus photography captures only part of a disease that involves the whole neurovascular unit and the retinal periphery. This narrative review summarizes the structural (optical coherence tomography, OCT), vascular (OCT angiography and ultra-widefield imaging) and functional (microperimetry, electrophysiology) biomarkers of DR, grades the evidence supporting each of them, and examines how artificial intelligence (AI) is changing screening, prognostication and treatment selection. Materials and Methods: PubMed/MEDLINE, Scopus and Web of Science were searched for publications from January 2000 to May 2026, giving priority to randomized trials, prospective multicentre cohorts, systematic reviews and externally validated algorithms. Results: Among imaging biomarkers, disorganization of the retinal inner layers, outer retinal integrity and ultra-widefield angiographic non-perfusion have the most consistent prognostic evidence, whereas OCT angiography metrics remain device-dependent. AI has progressed from research classifiers to autonomous systems with regulatory authorization in the United States and the European Union, to prospectively evaluated deployments in national programmes and low-resource settings, and to time-to-event progression models and foundation models. Image-based prediction improves discrimination over clinical risk factors by modest margins, and biomarker-guided treatment of diabetic macular oedema still rests largely on retrospective series. Cross-device standardization of quantitative metrics, representative datasets, prospective outcome trials and health-economic evidence remain the main gaps. Conclusions: Individualized screening intervals are the application closest to routine practice, whereas phenotype-driven therapy and precision monitoring remain promising but unproven.
zh_abstract: [Medicina (Kaunas, Lithuania)]【背景与目的】糖尿病视网膜病变（DR）仍是可预防视力丧失的主要原因。基于彩色眼底照相的分期只能捕捉涉及整个神经血管单元和视网膜周边部的疾病的一部分。本叙述性综述总结DR的结构性[光学相干断层扫描（OCT）]、血管性（OCT血管成像和超广角成像）和功能性（微视野检查、电生理）生物标志物，对支持各项标志物的证据进行分级，并探讨人工智能（AI）如何改变筛查、预后判断和治疗选择。【材料与方法】检索PubMed/MEDLINE、Scopus和Web of Science中2000年1月至2026年5月的出版物，优先纳入随机试验、前瞻性多中心队列、系统评价和外部验证算法。【结果】在影像生物标志物中，视网膜内层结构紊乱、外层视网膜完整性和超广角血管造影无灌注具有最一致的预后证据，而OCT血管成像指标仍依赖设备。AI已从研究分类器发展为在美国和欧盟获得监管授权的自主系统，发展为在国家项目和低资源环境中经前瞻性评估的部署，并发展为时间-事件进展模型和基础模型。基于图像的预测较临床危险因素在区分度上有小幅改善，而生物标志物指导的糖尿病性黄斑水肿治疗在很大程度上仍基于回顾性系列。定量指标的跨设备标准化、具有代表性的数据集、前瞻性结局试验和卫生经济学证据仍是主要空白。【结论】个体化筛查间隔是最接近常规实践的应用，而表型驱动治疗和精准监测仍有前景但尚未证实。

abstract: [Chinese journal of integrative medicine] A dual-model collaborative framework for intelligent acupuncture prescription recommendation was proposed. Specifically, symptom-to-acupoint mapping was formulated as an end-to-end text generation task and an intelligent recommendation method based on dual-model collaboration with consistency calibration (DM3C) was proposed. By combining a domain-fine-tuned generator, retrieval-augmented LLM outputs, and a consistency-calibrated random forest filter, the proposed DM3C enhances the generalizability and recall of intelligent acupuncture prescription recommendations, these findings demonstrate its potential as an auxiliary acupoint recommendation tool.

abstract: [Pharmaceuticals (Basel, Switzerland)] Generative and predictive artificial intelligence (AI) is rapidly increasing the number of molecular, structural, cellular, and therapeutic hypotheses that can be explored computationally. Experimental capacity, however, has not expanded at a comparable rate. The result is an evidence bottleneck, in which biological hypotheses are generated faster than they can be experimentally tested, reproduced, and translated. This mismatch is particularly consequential for pharmaceutical discovery, where computational predictions alone cannot establish biological function, mechanism, or therapeutic value. As the number of computationally generated hypotheses grows, the central challenge shifts from candidate generation to the prioritization of hypotheses for experimental validation. This evidence bottleneck represents a defining constraint of AI-enabled biological discovery. We examine how different biological claims, including structural, interaction, functional, mechanistic, and therapeutic claims, require distinct types and levels of evidence. We also address the cost and context-dependence of experimental validation. Furthermore, we discuss how information-guided experimental design and iterative model-experiment feedback can improve the allocation of limited experimental capacity. We propose an evidence-centric framework for drug discovery that extends the evaluation of generative models beyond their ability to generate or rank hypotheses. The framework emphasizes experimental testability, mechanistic understanding, reproducibility, and translation into actionable biological and therapeutic knowledge.
